preconditions.description: The number of students is at least 1 and at most 1000.
The number of buses is at least 1 and at most 10^9.
The number of days is at least 1 and at most 1000.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output.splitlines() and len(output.splitlines()) == d and all(len(line.split()) == n for line in output.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The output is either -1 or a valid arrangement of students in buses for d days. Each line contains n integers, each between 1 and k, representing the bus assignment for that day.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or all(all(line.split().count(str(bus)) == d for bus in range(1, k+1)) for line in output.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, each bus is used exactly d times across all days.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or not any(all(line.split().index(str(bus1)) < line.split().index(str(bus2)) for bus1 in line.split() for bus2 in line.split() if bus1 != bus2) for line in output.splitlines())
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, no two students are assigned to the same bus on all d days.
